title: Autopilot digital twin: a building and its elements, each with the evidence behind it

frame.description: The one coordinate frame every representation (structured model, splat, point cloud, web viewer) shares. Metres, x east, y north, z up, around origin.

ground_m.description: Ground level above sea level, where known

class.description: measured: by us, with an instrument or a scaled survey. documented: from an authoritative document (developer, approved drawings, a fit-out deck). reconstructed: derived from several photos or map data. estimated: inferred from limited evidence or typical values. unknown: no evidence; shown as a placeholder only.

confidence.description: Optional, and only where it can be computed (e.g. from reprojection error); never a made up score

id.description: Stable id, never reused: building.part.sub, e.g. skymark-f1.storey.1

geometry.description: Parameters the generator uses (heights, grid spacing, polygons), not a mesh

properties.description: Facts about it: material, area, tenant, capacity
